timing: device busy time per execution from the Neuron runtime system trace (nc_exec_running, per-core copies merged), the formal NKI timing method; no host interval; compilation and warmup outside the timed sessions
statistic: per point: median of the executions within each batch, then median of the batch medians; mode value: maximum over the valid points (stats.select_mode_value)
validity: correctness check passes AND every timed call is exactly one device execution of one executable

hbm.llc_equivalent: SBUF capacity of the scope (2 x 24 MiB): Trn2 has no hardware cache between HBM and SBUF; working sets >= 4 x 48 MiB are HBM-scale
hbm.work: read + write bytes (2 x buffer size), random int32 payload, output compared in full

gemm.api: torch.matmul on torch.device('neuron') (neuronx-cc compiled, the PyTorch eager library path)
gemm.check: C[:128,:128] against a float64 product of the same (rounded) operands

vector.api: NKI nisa.tensor_scalar(op0=multiply, op1=add) chains on SBUF-resident tiles, 2 FLOP per element
vector.scaling_check: the same point at 2 x iters must take 2x the time within 10 %
